main_text.p: גָּרוֹנָא, גָּרוֹן Ch. Guttur, ut Hebr.
גַּרְגָּר Ch. Gulosus, heluo, epulo, comessator, vorax, Deut.21.20. in T. Jon. Foemin. גַּרְגְּרָנִיתָא Luxuriosa, gulosa, Thren.1.11.
גָּרַשׁ Hebr. Expulit, ejecit. Ithpehal אִתְגְּרִיש Esth.6.1. quod legendum, אִתְרְגִּישׁ Commotus est.
גֻּשְׁמָא Ch. & Syr. Corpus, σῶμα. Plur. emph. גּוּשְׁמָיָא דְאִתְמְסִיאִן Corpora quae cotabuerunt, Ps.88.11.
גּוּשְׁפַּנְקָא Ch. Sigillum, annulus, annulus signatorius, Esth.3.10. Eccles.1.7.
גְּשַׁר Ch. Pons. Plur. גְּשָׁרִין, גְּשָׁרֵי Nah.2.6. cum aff. כָּל גִּשְׁרָךְ omnes pontes tuos, Ezech.27.5.
ܓܫܫ Syr. Palpare, contrectare: Impingere atttingendo, Act.27.41. Pahel גַּשֵּׁשׁ Ch. Idem, Gen.27.12.22. Jon. Ethpahel Part. ܡܬܓܫܫܐ Et contrectabilem, qui palpari possit, ad Hebr.12.18.
ܓܫܫܐ Syr. Explorator. Plur. ܓܫܫܝܢ Explora-tores, ad Hebr.11.31. Jac.2.25. Lucae 20.20.
הָא ה Ch. Haec, Ista: Hoc, istud, illud: Hinc com-positum, אִידָא Syr. ܐܝܢ Quae? Quod?
הָאַב Heb. Moestum esse. Chal. Pahel הַאֵב Moerore afficere. Hinc Particip. מְרָאֵבָן Moerore af-ficiunt

page.notes: Hebrew, Syriac and Greek entries were copied from the scan as far as legible; vowel points and some Syriac forms are uncertain and may contain errors. The faint mirrored text of the facing page (show-through) is not transcribed. The last entry is split across the end of the page as printed: "af-" and "ficiunt".
